map.权力和利益怎么打分，会不会太主观？: How Do You Score Power and Interest, and Is It Too Subjective?

map.资源受限下的相关方参与：对「令其满意」的高权低利方控制沟通频次与形式，「随时告知: Stakeholder engagement under resource constraints: for high-power low-interest "keep satisfied" parties limit the frequency and form of communication, and for low-power high-interest "keep informed" parties use a regular weekly report, so limited effort goes to high-value communication.
map.采用相对打分法（1-5 分）而非绝对测量：先横向比较所有相关方，再定档。可参考: Use a relative scoring method (1 to 5) rather than absolute measurement: compare all stakeholders horizontally first, then assign a grade. Refer to the common placements in the Mendelow power-interest matrix, where owners and investors are usually high power high interest, government regulators high power low interest, the front-line delivery team low power high interest, and the general public low power low interest. The scores need not be precise; the aim is to distinguish "who should be managed closely", so score them together with the core team at project start and keep a record.
map.重大变更或危机沟通：变更涉及强相关方时，用矩阵快速锁定「重点管理」对象，优先一对: For major change or crisis communication, when the change involves strongly related parties, use the matrix to quickly lock onto the "manage closely" targets and prioritise one-to-one communication, so a key opponent is not missed and the change is not blocked.
map.重点管理（高权高利）：密切参与、联合决策、高频一对一沟通，使其成为项目推动者；令: Manage closely (high power high interest): involve them closely, share decisions, and communicate one to one frequently so they become project champions; keep satisfied (high power low interest): give senior management periodic reports and precisely meet their key demands so they do not oppose out of neglect; keep informed (low power high interest): keep information transparent through weekly reports and review meetings so they feel respected; monitor (low power low interest): track developments at the lowest cost and escalate the communication only if needed. The strategy adjusts dynamically as the project progresses.
map.项目启动期干系人识别与分类：将业主、设计、施工、监理、政府监管部门、周边居民等按: Stakeholder identification and classification at project start: score the owner, designer, contractor, supervisor, government regulators, and surrounding residents from 1 to 5 on "power (ability to influence decisions)" and "interest (degree of being affected by the project)", place them in the four quadrants, and set differentiated management strategies accordingly.
map.：输入 4 名干系人（权力 1-5、利益 1-5）：业主(5,5)→关注度 25: : Enter 4 stakeholders (power 1-5, interest 1-5): owner (5,5) → attention 25 → manage closely (key player); government regulator (5,2) → attention 10 → keep satisfied; construction crew (2,5) → attention 10 → keep informed; surrounding residents (1,2) → attention 2 → monitor. Rules: power≥3 and interest≥3 is manage closely; power≥3 and interest<3 is keep satisfied; power<3 and interest≥3 is keep informed; power<3 and interest<3 is monitor. The result says the owner should be the top priority, the government kept satisfied through periodic senior reports that meet its key demands, the construction crew kept in the loop with weekly reports, and residents only monitored at the lowest cost.
